description: Opto-electronic RF synthesis combines photonic and electronic circuits to generate, mix, or modulate high-frequency signals. It targets very wide bandwidths and high carrier frequencies for future wireless and transport systems.

featured.title: A DAC-based Transmitter with VCSEL Bias-Current Generation enabling 180 Gbit/s PAM-8 Electrical and 100 Gbit/s PAM-4 VCSEL-based Transmission in 22nm SOI
featured.authors: U. Hecht, H. Ordouei, P. Scholz, P. Kurth, und F. Gerfers
featured.summary: Investigates “A DAC-based Transmitter with VCSEL Bias-Current Generation enabling 180 Gbit/s PAM-8 Electrical and 100 Gbit/s PAM-4 VCSEL-based…”. Focus: the core mechanism, system behavior and engineering implications in Photonic Systems & Integration, giving a quick view of the problem and its role in future wireless and network systems.
